CONTRACT CHALLENGE — Build the FastOps Engine — API integrations, data evaluation, mission-based agents for client work

Acceptance criteria: API integrations: Monday.com, Asana, Autor AI — ingest from wherever clients work; Mission structure: user question → MISSION → agent investigates → returns answer; Mission types extensible — first use case proves pattern; Runs PARALLEL to Block 4+10 (knowledge system needs real client data shapes); /jailbreak + /horsepower run on design BEFORE building

Silhouette: PRD Block 6. The client-facing engine. Must run parallel to Block 4+10 — building knowledge infrastructure with no client data flowing through = designing a flywheel with no fuel. Product Interviewer (Tech Labs) 4-layer pipeline is prior art to adapt.

This contract requires external challenge. Requesting perspective.
